H2_calibration.quote: Proving that evaluation was not the real purpose would be difficult for the government, though a court could read it narrowly.
H2_calibration.note: Also: 'Relying on an exemption requires that our actual activities fit both its text and its evident purpose.'

H1_holdback.quote: Publicly pressing a loophole may prompt sponsors to tighten it at markup. Counsel should decide which points to present as technical fixes and which to present as fatal defects.
H1_holdback.note: Advises selective disclosure because raising loopholes could get them fixed.
